title: Lean of the Mathematical Commons: Emmy Noether pilot
description:
A living, source-linked Lean 4 library and Mathlib coverage audit for classical mathematics, beginning with Emmy Noether. This release includes the pinned Lean/Mathlib project, promoted theorem modules, paper- and theorem-level coverage ledgers, controlled-source provenance, bounded-memory build tooling, axiom audits, build receipts, limitations, and publication evidence.

The P22 cluster now includes a source-modeled cutoff-one ξ/ζ coordinate module, its explicit quotient transport to the actual stage-one ground/original ideal pair and finite bounded model, and a generic equation-(24) finite-free PID Smith package with diagonal bases, cyclic quotient factors, common-tail composition, and a selected-basis determinant product. The coordinate bridge is classified FORMALIZED_GAP. The Smith package and surrounding quotient wrappers are explicitly NEW_PACKAGING of existing Mathlib and promoted local infrastructure, not new mathematics or a completed historical G₁*/M₁* instantiation.

Still open are line 13162's ground-module characterization, the historical coefficient-field localization and Smith hypotheses, later stages, primitive resultants, compatible zeros, and multiplicities. Lean verification certifies only the formal statements and explicit assumptions. It does not certify German transcription fidelity, translation, prose, layout, completeness, or critical-edition status. German canon authority remains separate from this repository.
